name: 白背心数字人

xyq.note: 小云雀 CLI 本机调用（pippit-tool-cli generate-video），配合 Seedance_2.5 / Seedance_2.0_mini_lite 与音频驱动对口型

renoise.note: （可选兼容）原 Renoise 远程 MCP 模式素材 ID。用 assets/avatar_ref.jpg 重新 upload_files 拿新 material id。

look: 年轻东亚女性，黑色长发带脸侧碎发，白色罗纹背心，竖屏自拍构图，室内自然光

voice.desc: young friendly female voice, clear and patient but lively, natural pace
voice.alt_clone: MiMo mimo-v2.5-tts-voiceclone，参照用 3 段口播拼的 ≥12 秒干声（见 references/voice.md）

acts.full: warm eye contact, expressive face, natural hand gestures, facing camera speaking naturally
acts.pip: calm explaining tone, small nods, occasionally glancing down as if reading a screen, small pointing gestures
acts.vlog: relaxed lifestyle vlogger sharing a favorite tool, natural small head tilts and nods, one hand comes up briefly in a casual gesture
acts.depth: medium shot with generous headroom and plain background visible on both sides of the head and shoulders (for text-behind-subject graphics), calm confident delivery

prompt_template:
The young woman in {ref} talks straight into her phone's front camera, same selfie framing, lighting and outfit as the reference, like a friendly Chinese tech vlogger {purpose}: {act}. Handheld selfie feel with only a very slight natural sway. She speaks Mandarin Chinese, clearly lip-synced, in a {voice}:
“{line}”
Sound: only her voice and quiet room tone, no music, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
xyq_prompt_template: 参考图中的年轻女性面向镜头自然口播，保持相同的发型、服装和自拍构图，光线柔和，表情生动，手势自然，对口型生动讲解，{act}。画面真实无杂物，无字幕水印。
disclosure: 内容由 AI 数字人演绎

me.name: 用户本人数字人（藏青 polo）
me.note: 用户本人照片，只给用户自己的片子用；横屏照直接出横屏口播
me.voice: warm, steady, confident male voice around 35 years old, natural pace
me.prompt_template: The man in {ref} talks straight to the camera, same framing, gray studio backdrop, navy polo shirt, glasses and soft lighting as the reference, like a friendly tech blogger {purpose}: {act}. Locked-off camera, no zoom. Clearly lip-synced. Sound: clear speech, no music, no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
me.xyq_prompt_template: 参考图中的男子面向镜头沉稳专业口播，保持相同发型服装与灰色演播室背景，对口型讲解，{act}。画面高清无字幕水印。

cat.name: 橘猫店长
cat.note: 提示词要写 its mouth clearly opens and closes in sync with the words

dog.name: 柴犬新闻主播
dog.voice: deep, serious male TV news-anchor voice

languages_tested.note: whisper 回听准确率实测；台词提前翻好再写进提示词
